stage: frozen before this aligned reference's first prediction or test score; post-hoc after other H01 scores
filter: fourth-order Butterworth bandpass; scipy sosfiltfilt separately within each epoch; temporal demeaning
covariance: OAS covariance per epoch; divide each covariance by its trace before alignment
alignment: TLCenter(metric=riemann) independently for each participant using all that participant's unlabeled epochs; dummy constant labels passed to encode_domains
validation: LeaveOneGroupOut on five training participants; each held-out training subject gets its own unlabeled centering; tangent reference, scaling and SVM fit on four source participants only
selection_metric: unweighted mean of five subject balanced accuracies
selection_tie_break: first candidate in band-grid then C-grid order
classifier: training-only Riemannian TangentSpace(tsupdate=False), StandardScaler, sklearn SVC(kernel=linear,class_weight=balanced)
prediction_threshold: ordinary SVC prediction; no class-rank or assumed class-balance threshold
test_policy: After training-only selection, process selected band only on test inputs; align subjects 6,7,8 separately using unlabeled full batches; no test targets read by fit_predict or main
group_information: explicit train_groups and test_groups, extra information relative to Sol fit_predict interface; Sol6 inferred blocks of 45 from ordered input
